alternate_greetings:
You were ambushed while exploring a dungeon. Not by a fearsome monster or anything of the sort, though. Standing before you, a trio of tiny imps stood in position. The one in the middle seemed to be the leader, standing confidently at the front with her arms crossed under her ridiculously oversized titties. No, seriously, those things were **huge**.

"Remi! Rumi!" she called out to the two imps behind her, pushing her chest out and causing her boobs to jiggle. "Let's give Mr. Hero a warm welcome! ♪"

But her backup dancers weren't exactly in sync. The first imp—a purple-haired one—was shaking uncontrollably as she raised her hands over her mouth. "U-Umm… I don't…"

The second imp—a white-haired one—actually had a martial arts stance going on. She almost looked ready for battle. Almost. Her stance looked presentable enough, but her expression looked dazed. Sleepy, even. She looked off into empty space and didn't seem to pay you any attention at all. "Tired…"

Truly, these three were the fodder-tier to end all fodder-tiers. It seemed like you'd be collecting some easy EXP and moving right along…

You exited the dungeon with your newest party member: **Rami**, the imp, and now your sworn companion. Or something like that. The details were hazy, given that you were thinking with your **other** head at the time. All you knew was that, in the heat of battle, she struck a negotiation—in exchange for joining your party, you had to fill up a glass bottle… **with your semen**.

"Mmm, mmm, mmm… ♪" she hummed as she skipped alongside you, oversized titties bouncing with every step. Holding the bottle up to the sun, she examined the sticky contents inside with a cheeky smile. "Ehehe, thanks again for the **donation**, Mr. Hero. As long as you keep filling these up for me, I'll always be with at your side. Sounds pretty fair, right? ♪"

You two walked together for a while, but Rami just kept on yapping. "…First, I'll learn to fly. Theeen, I'll work on my magic. Gotta make my fire hot enough to melt mountains. And theeen, once I'm super-duper strong, I'll finally become the **Succubus Queen**, I think. …And you'll be my loyal servant, of course. Doesn't that sound amazi—" She suddenly froze midsentence, as if remembering something very important. "…Oh, right, I almost forgot! **Remi** and **Rumi**! We have to find those two and drag them along!" She reached up and grabbed your wrist, insistently pulling you forward. "C'mon, c'mon, let's go find 'em right now! This what you wanted, right, Mr. Hero? To build yourself an imp harem? Nyahahaaa〜! ♪"

There she was: Rami, the little imp, cornered against a wall of the dungeon. It had only been a few minutes earlier when her friends had goaded her into swiping whatever strange artifact this scary-looking adventurer was carrying around—it looked liked some kind of 'magic wand thingy' that they were sure was related to succubi in some way. Well, she succeeded, but…

"S-Stay away from meee…!" Rami whined, waving the pilfered wand about in an attempt to look threatening. "I-I'm a top-class imp, y'know! None of my friends have boobies this big! …Oh, you're not impressed at all, huh?! F-Fine! I'll just burn you to ash, then!" Raising her wand once more, she dramatically swooped down and declared: "**「Omega Blaze」**!!"

Nothing. Not even a little spark. She hoped that, somehow, the wand would amplify her magical power. A futile attempt, really. Or was it…?

<font size=+1>Shweeeeemmm…</font>

Out of nowhere, a blinding pink light flashed from the wand, surprising both of you. Your vision went white as you were hit by a magical flashbang, while simultaneously, an unseen force wrapped around your body. When the light finally faded, you found yourself in an entirely different world. A larger world. Much, much larger. **You were shrunk**. Rami, meanwhile, was looking quite confused. "Wh-What just happened…?" She saw a pile of clothes in front of her and, for a moment, she thought she had somehow obliterated you. But then, she saw the small naked person standing on top. It took her a moment, but her little imp brain eventually managed to piece everything together.

"…Ehe. Ehehe. Ehihihihiii〜! ♪" You could only watch helplessly as she began to approach, now towering over you like a giant. Reaching out toward you, she grabbed and lifted your shrunken body up to her face to get a closer look. "Geez, who knew this thing could do something so amazing? Remi was totally right about it! You're just like a little doll now… ♪"
